it.title: L'agenzia Cliburn
it.description:
La Cliburn Agency è una boutique a servizio completo che offre servizi completi di gestione generale, prenotazione concerti, gestione progetti, pubblicità e branding a un gruppo selezionato di strumentisti emergenti e affermati, pianisti e non solo, il cui alto livello artistico è accompagnato da una visione volta a far progredire il campo della musica classica.

Il roster della Cliburn Agency comprende Anderson & Roe Piano Duo (@andersonroe); Greg Anderson, pianoforte (@gregandersonpiano); Peter Dugan, pianoforte (@peterdugan9983); Fei-Fei, pianoforte (@feifeipianist); Bridget Kibbey, arpa (@bridgetkibbey); Joshua Roman, violoncello (@JoshuaRomanCello); e Clayton Stephenson, pianoforte (@Claytonplayspiano). Da programmi e progetti intriganti a concerti alternativi e coinvolgimento della comunità, i musicisti in tournée dell'Agenzia si dedicano alla connessione e alla creatività e collaborano con il Cliburn per migliorare e amplificare le loro carriere, il loro impegno e il loro impatto.

Scopri di più su https://cliburnagency.com/

"La Cliburn Agency rappresenta un'espansione avvincente del marchio e dell'impatto del Cliburn. La nostra missione principale è supportare gli artisti e promuovere costantemente la musica classica. La gestione e la promozione di musicisti eccezionali, in particolare quelli con un fervore e una dedizione specifici per ampliare il pubblico e abbattere le barriere, è il passo successivo per realizzare questa missione. Attraverso questo nuovo programma, il Cliburn sviluppa un altro modo efficace per cogliere il momento e trovare nuovi modi per espandere la portata della musica classica come fonte di comunanza ed esperienza condivisa nel mondo di oggi."
– Jacques Marquis, presidente e CEO

ru.title: Агентство Клиберна
ru.description:
Агентство Cliburn — это многопрофильная компания, предлагающая полный спектр услуг по общему управлению, бронированию концертов, управлению проектами, а также рекламе и брендингу для избранной группы начинающих и опытных инструменталистов — как пианистов, так и музыкантов других жанров, — чей высокий артистический уровень сочетается с видением развития классической музыки.

В состав агентства Cliburn входят: дуэт Anderson & Roe Piano (@andersonroe); Грег Андерсон, фортепиано (@gregandersonpiano); Питер Дуган, фортепиано (@peterdugan9983); Фей-Фей, фортепиано (@feifeipianist); Бриджет Кибби, арфа (@bridgetkibbey); Джошуа Роман, виолончель (@JoshuaRomanCello); и Клейтон Стивенсон, фортепиано (@Claytonplayspiano). От интересных программ и проектов до альтернативных концертов и взаимодействия с общественностью, гастролирующие музыканты агентства Cliburn стремятся к налаживанию связей и творчеству. Они сотрудничают с Cliburn Agency, чтобы развивать и расширять свою карьеру, начинания и влияние.

Подробнее на сайте https://cliburnagency.com/

«Cliburn Agency — это впечатляющее расширение бренда Cliburn и его влияния. Наша основная миссия — поддержка артистов и постоянное развитие классической музыки. Менеджмент и продвижение выдающихся музыкантов, особенно тех, кто обладает особым энтузиазмом и стремлением расширять аудиторию и разрушать барьеры, — это следующий шаг на пути к реализации этой миссии. Благодаря этой новой программе Cliburn Agency разрабатывает ещё один эффективный способ соответствовать текущему моменту и находить новые пути для расширения охвата классической музыки как источника общности и общего опыта в современном мире».
— Жак Марки, президент и генеральный директор

pa.title: ਕਲਿਬਰਨ ਏਜੰਸੀ
pa.description:
ਕਲਿਬਰਨ ਏਜੰਸੀ ਇੱਕ ਪੂਰੀ-ਸੇਵਾ ਵਾਲੀ ਬੁਟੀਕ ਫਰਮ ਹੈ ਜੋ ਉੱਭਰ ਰਹੇ ਅਤੇ ਸਥਾਪਿਤ ਸਾਜ਼-ਵਾਦਕਾਂ ਦੇ ਇੱਕ ਚੋਣਵੇਂ ਸਮੂਹ ਨੂੰ ਵਿਆਪਕ ਜਨਰਲ ਪ੍ਰਬੰਧਨ, ਕੰਸਰਟ ਬੁਕਿੰਗ, ਪ੍ਰੋਜੈਕਟ ਪ੍ਰਬੰਧਨ, ਅਤੇ ਪ੍ਰਚਾਰ ਅਤੇ ਬ੍ਰਾਂਡਿੰਗ ਸੇਵਾਵਾਂ ਪ੍ਰਦਾਨ ਕਰਦੀ ਹੈ - ਪਿਆਨੋ ਅਤੇ ਇਸ ਤੋਂ ਪਰੇ - ਜਿਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦੀ ਉੱਚ ਕਲਾਤਮਕ ਯੋਗਤਾ ਸ਼ਾਸਤਰੀ ਸੰਗੀਤ ਦੇ ਖੇਤਰ ਨੂੰ ਅੱਗੇ ਵਧਾਉਣ ਦੇ ਦ੍ਰਿਸ਼ਟੀਕੋਣ ਨਾਲ ਮੇਲ ਖਾਂਦੀ ਹੈ।

ਕਲਿਬਰਨ ਏਜੰਸੀ ਰੋਸਟਰ ਵਿੱਚ ਐਂਡਰਸਨ ਅਤੇ ਰੋ ਪਿਆਨੋ ਜੋੜੀ (@andersonroe); ਗ੍ਰੇਗ ਐਂਡਰਸਨ, ਪਿਆਨੋ (@gregandersonpiano); ਪੀਟਰ ਡੂਗਨ, ਪਿਆਨੋ (@peterdugan9983); ਫੀ-ਫੀ, ਪਿਆਨੋ (@feifeipianist); ਬ੍ਰਿਜੇਟ ਕਿੱਬੀ, ਹਾਰਪ (@bridgetkibbey); ਜੋਸ਼ੂਆ ਰੋਮਨ, ਸੈਲੋ (@JoshuaRomanCello); ਅਤੇ ਕਲੇਟਨ ਸਟੀਫਨਸਨ, ਪਿਆਨੋ (@Claytonplayspiano) ਸ਼ਾਮਲ ਹਨ। ਦਿਲਚਸਪ ਪ੍ਰੋਗਰਾਮਿੰਗ ਅਤੇ ਪ੍ਰੋਜੈਕਟਾਂ ਤੋਂ ਲੈ ਕੇ ਵਿਕਲਪਕ ਸੰਗੀਤ ਸਮਾਰੋਹਾਂ ਅਤੇ ਭਾਈਚਾਰਕ ਸ਼ਮੂਲੀਅਤ ਤੱਕ, ਏਜੰਸੀ ਰੋਸਟਰ ਦੇ ਟੂਰਿੰਗ ਸੰਗੀਤਕਾਰ ਕਨੈਕਸ਼ਨ ਅਤੇ ਰਚਨਾਤਮਕਤਾ ਲਈ ਸਮਰਪਿਤ ਹਨ - ਅਤੇ ਉਹ ਆਪਣੇ ਕਰੀਅਰ, ਯਤਨਾਂ ਅਤੇ ਪ੍ਰਭਾਵ ਨੂੰ ਵਧਾਉਣ ਅਤੇ ਵਧਾਉਣ ਲਈ ਕਲਿਬਰਨ ਨਾਲ ਸਾਂਝੇਦਾਰੀ ਕਰ ਰਹੇ ਹਨ।

https://cliburnagency.com/ 'ਤੇ ਹੋਰ ਜਾਣੋ

“ਕਲਿਬਰਨ ਏਜੰਸੀ ਕਲਿਬਰਨ ਦੇ ਬ੍ਰਾਂਡ ਅਤੇ ਪ੍ਰਭਾਵ ਦਾ ਇੱਕ ਪ੍ਰਭਾਵਸ਼ਾਲੀ ਵਿਸਥਾਰ ਹੈ। ਸਾਡਾ ਮੁੱਖ ਮਿਸ਼ਨ ਕਲਾਕਾਰਾਂ ਦਾ ਸਮਰਥਨ ਕਰਨਾ ਅਤੇ ਕਲਾਸੀਕਲ ਸੰਗੀਤ ਨੂੰ ਨਿਰੰਤਰ ਅੱਗੇ ਵਧਾਉਣਾ ਹੈ। ਬੇਮਿਸਾਲ ਸੰਗੀਤਕਾਰਾਂ ਦਾ ਪ੍ਰਬੰਧਨ ਅਤੇ ਪ੍ਰਚਾਰ - ਖਾਸ ਤੌਰ 'ਤੇ ਉਹ ਜੋ ਦਰਸ਼ਕਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਵਧਾਉਣ ਅਤੇ ਰੁਕਾਵਟਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਤੋੜਨ ਲਈ ਇੱਕ ਖਾਸ ਜੋਸ਼ ਅਤੇ ਸਮਰਪਣ ਵਾਲੇ - ਉਸ ਮਿਸ਼ਨ ਨੂੰ ਸਾਕਾਰ ਕਰਨ ਦਾ ਅਗਲਾ ਕਦਮ ਹੈ। ਇਸ ਨਵੇਂ ਪ੍ਰੋਗਰਾਮ ਰਾਹੀਂ, ਕਲਿਬਰਨ ਇਸ ਪਲ ਨੂੰ ਪੂਰਾ ਕਰਨ ਅਤੇ ਅੱਜ ਦੀ ਦੁਨੀਆ ਵਿੱਚ ਸਾਂਝੀਵਾਲਤਾ ਅਤੇ ਸਾਂਝੇ ਅਨੁਭਵ ਦੇ ਸਰੋਤ ਵਜੋਂ ਕਲਾਸੀਕਲ ਸੰਗੀਤ ਦੀ ਪਹੁੰਚ ਨੂੰ ਵਧਾਉਣ ਦੇ ਨਵੇਂ ਤਰੀਕੇ ਲੱਭਣ ਦਾ ਇੱਕ ਹੋਰ ਸ਼ਕਤੀਸ਼ਾਲੀ ਤਰੀਕਾ ਵਿਕਸਤ ਕਰਦਾ ਹੈ।”
– ਜੈਕ ਮਾਰਕਿਸ, ਪ੍ਰਧਾਨ ਅਤੇ ਸੀਈਓ

de-DE.title: Die Cliburn-Agentur
de-DE.description:
Die Cliburn Agency ist ein Full-Service-Unternehmen, das einer ausgewählten Gruppe aufstrebender und etablierter Instrumentalisten – Klavier und mehr – umfassende Dienstleistungen in den Bereichen General Management, Konzertbuchung, Projektmanagement sowie Öffentlichkeitsarbeit und Branding bietet. Ihr hohes künstlerisches Können geht Hand in Hand mit der Vision, die klassische Musik voranzubringen.

Zu den Mitgliedern der Cliburn Agency gehören Anderson & Roe Piano Duo (@andersonroe); Greg Anderson, Klavier (@gregandersonpiano); Peter Dugan, Klavier (@peterdugan9983); Fei-Fei, Klavier (@feifeipianist); Bridget Kibbey, Harfe (@bridgetkibbey); Joshua Roman, Cello (@JoshuaRomanCello); und Clayton Stephenson, Klavier (@Claytonplayspiano). Von spannenden Programmen und Projekten bis hin zu alternativen Konzerten und gesellschaftlichem Engagement – ​​die tourenden Musiker der Agentur engagieren sich für Vernetzung und Kreativität. Gemeinsam mit dem Cliburn arbeiten sie daran, ihre Karrieren, ihr Engagement und ihre Wirkung zu stärken und zu verstärken.

Mehr erfahren unter https://cliburnagency.com/

„Die Cliburn Agency ist eine überzeugende Erweiterung der Marke und Wirkung des Cliburn. Unsere Kernaufgabe ist es, Künstler zu unterstützen und die klassische Musik kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln. Das Management und die Förderung außergewöhnlicher Musiker – insbesondere jener, die sich mit besonderer Leidenschaft und Hingabe dafür einsetzen, ihr Publikum zu erweitern und Barrieren abzubauen – ist der nächste Schritt zur Verwirklichung dieser Mission. Mit diesem neuen Programm entwickelt das Cliburn eine weitere wirkungsvolle Möglichkeit, den Moment zu erleben und neue Wege zu finden, die Reichweite klassischer Musik als Quelle der Gemeinsamkeit und des gemeinsamen Erlebens in der heutigen Welt zu erweitern.“
– Jacques Marquis, Präsident und CEO

te.title: ది క్లిబర్న్ ఏజెన్సీ
te.description:
క్లిబర్న్ ఏజెన్సీ అనేది పూర్తి స్థాయి బోటిక్ సంస్థ, ఇది పియానో ​​మరియు అంతకు మించి అభివృద్ధి చెందుతున్న మరియు స్థిరపడిన వాయిద్యకారుల ఎంపిక చేసిన సమూహానికి సమగ్ర జనరల్ మేనేజ్‌మెంట్, కచేరీ బుకింగ్, ప్రాజెక్ట్ నిర్వహణ మరియు ప్రచారం మరియు బ్రాండింగ్ సేవలను అందిస్తుంది - వీరి అధిక కళాత్మక నైపుణ్యం శాస్త్రీయ సంగీత రంగాన్ని ముందుకు తీసుకెళ్లే దృక్పథంతో సరిపోతుంది.

క్లిబర్న్ ఏజెన్సీ జాబితాలో ఆండర్సన్ & రో పియానో ​​డుయో (@andersonroe); గ్రెగ్ ఆండర్సన్, పియానో ​​(@gregandersonpiano) ; పీటర్ డుగన్, పియానో ​​(@peterdugan9983) ; ఫీ-ఫీ, పియానో ​​(@feefeipianist) ; బ్రిడ్జేట్ కిబ్బే, హార్ప్ (@bridgetkibbey); జాషువా రోమన్, సెల్లో (@JoshuaRomanCello) ; మరియు క్లేటన్ స్టీఫెన్‌సన్, పియానో ​​(@Claytonplayspiano) ఉన్నారు. ఆసక్తికరమైన ప్రోగ్రామింగ్ మరియు ప్రాజెక్ట్‌ల నుండి ప్రత్యామ్నాయ కచేరీలు మరియు కమ్యూనిటీ నిశ్చితార్థం వరకు, ఏజెన్సీ రోస్టర్‌లోని టూరింగ్ సంగీతకారులు కనెక్షన్ మరియు సృజనాత్మకతకు అంకితభావంతో ఉన్నారు - మరియు వారు వారి కెరీర్‌లను, ప్రయత్నాలను మరియు ప్రభావాన్ని మెరుగుపరచడానికి మరియు విస్తరించడానికి క్లిబర్న్‌తో భాగస్వామ్యం చేస్తున్నారు.

https://cliburnagency.com/ లో మరింత తెలుసుకోండి

“క్లిబర్న్ ఏజెన్సీ అనేది క్లిబర్న్ బ్రాండ్ మరియు ప్రభావం యొక్క బలవంతపు విస్తరణ. కళాకారులకు మద్దతు ఇవ్వడం మరియు శాస్త్రీయ సంగీతాన్ని నిరంతరం ముందుకు తీసుకెళ్లడం మా ప్రధాన లక్ష్యం. అసాధారణ సంగీతకారుల నిర్వహణ మరియు ప్రచారం - ముఖ్యంగా ప్రేక్షకులను విస్తరించడానికి మరియు అడ్డంకులను ఛేదించడానికి నిర్దిష్ట ఉత్సాహం మరియు అంకితభావం ఉన్నవారు - ఆ లక్ష్యాన్ని సాధించడంలో తదుపరి దశ. ఈ కొత్త కార్యక్రమం ద్వారా, క్లిబర్న్ ప్రస్తుత క్షణాన్ని చేరుకోవడానికి మరియు నేటి ప్రపంచంలో ఉమ్మడిత్వం మరియు భాగస్వామ్య అనుభవానికి మూలంగా శాస్త్రీయ సంగీతం యొక్క పరిధిని విస్తరించడానికి కొత్త మార్గాలను కనుగొనడానికి మరొక శక్తివంతమైన మార్గాన్ని అభివృద్ధి చేస్తుంది.”
– జాక్వెస్ మార్క్విస్, అధ్యక్షుడు & CEO

ar.title: وكالة كليبرن
ar.description:
وكالة كليبرن هي شركة متخصصة متكاملة الخدمات، تقدم خدمات الإدارة العامة الشاملة، وحجز الحفلات الموسيقية، وإدارة المشاريع، وخدمات الدعاية والترويج لمجموعة مختارة من العازفين الصاعدين والمخضرمين - البيانو وما فوق - الذين تتوافق قدراتهم الفنية العالية مع رؤيتهم للارتقاء بمجال الموسيقى الكلاسيكية.

تضم قائمة موظفي وكالة كليبرن ثنائي البيانو أندرسون ورو (@andersonroe)؛ وجريج أندرسون (@gregandersonpiano)؛ وبيتر دوغان (@peterdugan9983)؛ وفاي فاي (@feifeipianist)؛ وبريدجيت كيبي (@bridgetkibbey)؛ وجوشوا رومان (@JoshuaRomanCello)؛ وكلايتون ستيفنسون (@Claytonplayspiano). من البرامج والمشاريع الشيقة إلى الحفلات الموسيقية البديلة والمشاركة المجتمعية، يلتزم موسيقيو الوكالة المتجولون بالتواصل والإبداع، ويتعاونون مع كليبورن لتعزيز مسيرتهم المهنية وجهودهم وتأثيرهم.

تعرّف على المزيد عبر https://cliburnagency.com/

"وكالة كليبورن هي امتدادٌ قويٌّ لعلامة كليبورن التجارية وتأثيرها. مهمتنا الأساسية هي دعم الفنانين والارتقاء المستمر بالموسيقى الكلاسيكية. إن إدارة وترويج الموسيقيين المتميزين - وخاصةً أولئك الذين يتمتعون بحماسٍ وتفانٍ خاصين لتوسيع قاعدة جماهيرهم وكسر الحواجز - هي الخطوة التالية في تحقيق هذه المهمة. من خلال هذا البرنامج الجديد، تُطوّر كليبورن طريقةً فعّالةً أخرى لمواكبة العصر وإيجاد طرقٍ جديدةٍ لتوسيع نطاق الموسيقى الكلاسيكية كمصدرٍ للقواسم المشتركة والتجارب المشتركة في عالم اليوم."

- جاك ماركيز، الرئيس والمدير التنفيذي

ml.title: ദി ക്ലിബേൺ ഏജൻസി
ml.description:
ക്ലിബേൺ ഏജൻസി ഒരു സമ്പൂർണ്ണ സേവന ബൊട്ടീക്ക് സ്ഥാപനമാണ്, ഇത് പിയാനോ പോലുള്ള ഉയർന്നുവരുന്ന, സ്ഥാപിതമായ ഉപകരണ വിദഗ്ദ്ധരുടെ ഒരു തിരഞ്ഞെടുത്ത ഗ്രൂപ്പിന് സമഗ്രമായ ജനറൽ മാനേജ്മെന്റ്, കച്ചേരി ബുക്കിംഗ്, പ്രോജക്ട് മാനേജ്മെന്റ്, പബ്ലിസിറ്റി, ബ്രാൻഡിംഗ് സേവനങ്ങൾ എന്നിവ വാഗ്ദാനം ചെയ്യുന്നു. ക്ലാസിക്കൽ സംഗീത മേഖലയെ മുന്നോട്ട് കൊണ്ടുപോകുന്നതിനുള്ള ഒരു ദർശനവുമായി ഉയർന്ന കലാപരമായ കഴിവ് പൊരുത്തപ്പെടുന്നു.

ക്ലിബേൺ ഏജൻസി റോസ്റ്ററിൽ ആൻഡേഴ്സൺ & റോ പിയാനോ ഡ്യുവോ (@andersonroe); ഗ്രെഗ് ആൻഡേഴ്സൺ, പിയാനോ (@gregandersonpiano) ; പീറ്റർ ഡുഗൻ, പിയാനോ (@peterdugan9983) ; ഫെയ്-ഫെയ്, പിയാനോ (@feifeipianist) ; ബ്രിഡ്ജറ്റ് കിബ്ബെ, ഹാർപ്പ് (@bridgetkibbey); ജോഷ്വ റോമൻ, സെല്ലോ (@JoshuaRomanCello) ; ക്ലേയ്‌റ്റൺ സ്റ്റീഫൻസൺ, പിയാനോ (@Claytonplayspiano) എന്നിവ ഉൾപ്പെടുന്നു. കൗതുകകരമായ പ്രോഗ്രാമിംഗും പ്രോജക്റ്റുകളും മുതൽ ബദൽ കച്ചേരികളും കമ്മ്യൂണിറ്റി ഇടപെടലും വരെ, ഏജൻസി റോസ്റ്ററിലെ ടൂറിംഗ് സംഗീതജ്ഞർ കണക്ഷനും സർഗ്ഗാത്മകതയും സമർപ്പിതരാണ് - അവരുടെ കരിയർ, പരിശ്രമങ്ങൾ, സ്വാധീനം എന്നിവ മെച്ചപ്പെടുത്തുന്നതിനും വലുതാക്കുന്നതിനുമായി അവർ ക്ലിബേണുമായി പങ്കാളിത്തം സ്ഥാപിക്കുന്നു.

കൂടുതലറിയാൻ https://cliburnagency.com/ സന്ദർശിക്കുക

“ക്ലിബേണിന്റെ ബ്രാൻഡിന്റെയും സ്വാധീനത്തിന്റെയും ശ്രദ്ധേയമായ ഒരു വികാസമാണ് ക്ലിബേൺ ഏജൻസി. കലാകാരന്മാരെ പിന്തുണയ്ക്കുകയും ക്ലാസിക്കൽ സംഗീതത്തെ തുടർച്ചയായി മുന്നോട്ട് കൊണ്ടുപോകുകയും ചെയ്യുക എന്നതാണ് ഞങ്ങളുടെ പ്രധാന ദൗത്യം. പ്രത്യേകിച്ച് പ്രേക്ഷകരെ വികസിപ്പിക്കുന്നതിനും തടസ്സങ്ങൾ തകർക്കുന്നതിനുമായി പ്രത്യേക തീക്ഷ്ണതയും സമർപ്പണവുമുള്ള അസാധാരണ സംഗീതജ്ഞരുടെ മാനേജ്മെന്റും പ്രൊമോഷനും ആ ദൗത്യം സാക്ഷാത്കരിക്കുന്നതിനുള്ള അടുത്ത ഘട്ടമാണ്. ഈ പുതിയ പ്രോഗ്രാമിലൂടെ, ഇന്നത്തെ ലോകത്ത് പൊതുവായതും പങ്കിട്ടതുമായ അനുഭവത്തിന്റെ ഉറവിടമായി ക്ലാസിക്കൽ സംഗീതത്തിന്റെ വ്യാപ്തി വർദ്ധിപ്പിക്കുന്നതിനുള്ള പുതിയ വഴികൾ കണ്ടെത്തുന്നതിനും ഈ നിമിഷം നിറവേറ്റുന്നതിനുമുള്ള മറ്റൊരു ശക്തമായ മാർഗം ക്ലിബേൺ വികസിപ്പിക്കുന്നു.”
– ജാക്വസ് മാർക്വിസ്, പ്രസിഡന്റ് & സിഇഒ

uk.title: Агентство Кліберна
uk.description:
Агентство «Кліберн» – це бутикова фірма з повним спектром послуг, що пропонує комплексне управління, бронювання концертів, управління проектами, а також послуги з реклами та брендингу для обраної групи молодих та відомих інструменталістів – як піаністів, так і інших – чий високий художній рівень поєднується з баченням розвитку галузі класичної музики.

До складу Агентства «Кліберн» входять: фортепіанний дует Андерсона та Роу (@andersonroe); Грег Андерсон, фортепіано (@gregandersonpiano); Пітер Дуган, фортепіано (@peterdugan9983); Фей-Фей, фортепіано (@feifeipianist); Бріджит Кіббі, арфа (@bridgetkibbey); Джошуа Роман, віолончель (@JoshuaRomanCello); та Клейтон Стівенсон, фортепіано (@Claytonplayspiano). Від захопливих програм та проектів до альтернативних концертів та залучення громади, гастролюючі музиканти зі складу Агентства присвячені зв'язку та творчості, і вони співпрацюють з Клайберном, щоб покращити та примножити свою кар'єру, зусилля та вплив.

Дізнайтеся більше на https://cliburnagency.com/

«Агентство Cliburn — це переконливе розширення бренду та впливу Cliburn. Наша основна місія — підтримувати артистів та постійно розвивати класичну музику. Управління та просування виняткових музикантів, особливо тих, хто має особливе запал та відданість розширенню аудиторії та подоланню бар'єрів, — це наступний крок у реалізації цієї місії. Завдяки цій новій програмі Cliburn розробляє ще один потужний спосіб зустрічати момент та знаходити нові шляхи розширення охоплення класичної музики як джерела спільності та спільного досвіду в сучасному світі».
– Жак Маркіз, президент і генеральний директор

fr-FR.title: L'Agence Cliburn
fr-FR.description:
L'Agence Cliburn est une agence multiservices proposant des services complets de gestion générale, de réservation de concerts, de gestion de projets, de publicité et de branding à un groupe restreint d'instrumentistes, qu'ils soient pianistes ou non, dont le haut niveau artistique s'accompagne d'une volonté de faire progresser la musique classique.

L'Agence Cliburn comprend : Anderson & Roe Piano Duo (@andersonroe) ; Greg Anderson, piano (@gregandersonpiano) ; Peter Dugan, piano (@peterdugan9983) ; Fei-Fei, piano (@feifeipianist) ; Bridget Kibbey, harpe (@bridgetkibbey) ; Joshua Roman, violoncelle (@JoshuaRomanCello) ; et Clayton Stephenson, piano (@Claytonplayspiano). De la programmation et des projets captivants aux concerts alternatifs et à l'engagement communautaire, les musiciens en tournée de l'Agence sont attachés à la connexion et à la créativité. Ils s'associent au Cliburn pour dynamiser et amplifier leur carrière, leurs efforts et leur impact.

Pour en savoir plus, rendez-vous sur https://cliburnagency.com/

« L'Agence Cliburn représente une avancée majeure pour la marque et l'influence du Cliburn. Notre mission principale est de soutenir les artistes et de promouvoir sans cesse la musique classique. L'encadrement et la promotion de musiciens exceptionnels, notamment ceux qui s'investissent avec ferveur et dévouement pour élargir le public et faire tomber les barrières, constituent la prochaine étape de cette mission. Grâce à ce nouveau programme, le Cliburn développe une nouvelle approche efficace pour saisir l'instant présent et trouver de nouvelles façons de faire rayonner la musique classique comme source de communauté et d'expérience partagée dans le monde d'aujourd'hui. »

– Jacques Marquis, président-directeur général

pt-BR.title: A Agência Cliburn
pt-BR.description:
A Cliburn Agency é uma empresa boutique de serviços completos que oferece serviços abrangentes de gestão geral, agendamento de concertos, gerenciamento de projetos e serviços de publicidade e branding para um seleto grupo de instrumentistas em ascensão e consagrados — piano e outros — cujo alto calibre artístico é acompanhado por uma visão de impulsionar o campo da música clássica.

A Cliburn Agency conta com Anderson & Roe Piano Duo (@andersonroe); Greg Anderson, piano (@gregandersonpiano); Peter Dugan, piano (@peterdugan9983); Fei-Fei, piano (@feifeipianist); Bridget Kibbey, harpa (@bridgetkibbey); Joshua Roman, violoncelo (@JoshuaRomanCello); e Clayton Stephenson, piano (@Claytonplayspiano). De programação e projetos intrigantes a concertos alternativos e engajamento comunitário, os músicos itinerantes da Agência se dedicam à conexão e à criatividade — e estão em parceria com a Cliburn para aprimorar e ampliar suas carreiras, esforços e impacto.

Saiba mais em https://cliburnagency.com/

“A Cliburn Agency é uma expansão convincente da marca e do impacto da Cliburn. Nossa missão principal é apoiar artistas e promover continuamente a música clássica. A gestão e a promoção de músicos excepcionais — particularmente aqueles com um fervor e dedicação específicos para expandir públicos e quebrar barreiras — é o próximo passo para concretizar essa missão. Por meio deste novo programa, a Cliburn desenvolve outra maneira poderosa de aproveitar o momento e encontrar novas maneiras de expandir o alcance da música clássica como fonte de comunhão e experiência compartilhada no mundo de hoje.”
– Jacques Marquis, presidente e CEO

en.title: The Cliburn Agency
en.description:
The Cliburn Agency is a full-service boutique firm that offers comprehensive general management, concert booking, project management, and publicity and branding services to a select group of rising and established instrumentalists—piano and beyond—whose high artistic caliber is matched by a vision for moving the field of classical music forward.

The Cliburn Agency roster comprises Anderson & Roe Piano Duo (@andersonroe);  Greg Anderson, piano (@gregandersonpiano) ; Peter Dugan, piano (@peterdugan9983) ; Fei-Fei, piano (@feifeipianist) ; Bridget Kibbey, harp (@bridgetkibbey);  Joshua Roman, cello (@JoshuaRomanCello) ; and Clayton Stephenson, piano (@Claytonplayspiano) . From intriguing programming and projects to alternative concerts and community engagement, the touring musicians of the Agency roster are dedicated to connection and creativity—and they are partnering with the Cliburn to enhance and magnify their careers, efforts, and impact.

Learn more at https://cliburnagency.com/

“The Cliburn Agency is a compelling expansion of the Cliburn’s brand and impact. Our core mission is to support artists and continuously advance classical music. The management and promotion of exceptional musicians—particularly those with a specific fervor and dedication for expanding audiences and breaking down barriers—is the next step in realizing that mission. Through this new program, the Cliburn develops another powerful way to meet the moment and find new ways to expand classical music’s reach as a source of commonality and shared experience in today’s world.”
– Jacques Marquis, president & CEO

ko.title: 클라이번 에이전시
ko.description:
클라이번 에이전시는 높은 예술적 역량과 클래식 음악 분야를 발전시키겠다는 비전을 가진, 피아노를 포함한 다양한 분야의 신진 및 기성 연주자들을 엄선하여 종합적인 총괄 관리, 콘서트 예약, 프로젝트 관리, 홍보 및 브랜딩 서비스를 제공하는 종합 부티크 회사입니다.

클라이번 에이전시는 앤더슨 & 로 피아노 듀오(@andersonroe), 그렉 앤더슨(피아노), 피터 두건(피아노), 피터 듀건(피아노), 페이페이(피아노), 브리짓 키비(하프), 조슈아 로만(첼로), 클레이튼 스티븐슨(피아노), 클레이튼 플레이스피아노로 구성되어 있습니다. 흥미로운 프로그램과 프로젝트부터 대안 콘서트와 지역 사회 참여에 이르기까지, 에이전시 소속 순회 음악가들은 소통과 창의성에 헌신하며, 클라이번과 협력하여 그들의 경력, 노력, 그리고 영향력을 향상시키고 확대하고 있습니다.

자세한 내용은 https://cliburnagency.com/ 에서 확인하세요.

"클라이번 에이전시는 클라이번의 브랜드와 영향력을 더욱 확장하는 매력적인 프로젝트입니다. 저희의 핵심 사명은 아티스트들을 지원하고 클래식 음악을 지속적으로 발전시키는 것입니다. 뛰어난 음악가, 특히 청중 확대와 장벽 허물기에 대한 열정과 헌신을 가진 아티스트들을 관리하고 홍보하는 것은 이러한 사명을 실현하는 다음 단계입니다. 이 새로운 프로그램을 통해 클라이번은 순간을 포착하고, 오늘날 세상에서 공통성과 공유 경험의 원천으로서 클래식 음악의 영향력을 확장할 새로운 방법을 모색하는 또 다른 강력한 방법을 개발합니다."
– 자크 마르키, 사장 겸 CEO

iw.title: סוכנות קליבורן
iw.description:
סוכנות Cliburn היא חברת בוטיק המציעה שירותי ניהול כללי מקיפים, הזמנת קונצרטים, ניהול פרויקטים, שירותי פרסום ומיתוג לקבוצה נבחרת של נגני נגינה עולים וותיקים - פסנתר ומעבר - אשר איכותם האמנותית הגבוהה משתווה לחזון לקידום תחום המוזיקה הקלאסית.

רשימת נגני Cliburn Agency מורכבת מ-Anderson & Roe Piano Duo (@andersonroe); גרג אנדרסון, פסנתר (@gregandersonpiano); פיטר דוגן, פסנתר (@peterdugan9983); פיי-פיי, פסנתר (@feifeipianist); ברידג'ט קיבי, נבל (@bridgetkibbey); ג'ושוע רומן, צ'לו (@JoshuaRomanCello); וקלייטון סטפנסון, פסנתר (@Claytonplayspiano). החל מתכנות ופרויקטים מסקרנים ועד קונצרטים אלטרנטיביים ומעורבות קהילתית, המוזיקאים הנודדים של רשימת הסוכנות מחויבים לחיבור ויצירתיות - והם משתפים פעולה עם Cliburn כדי לשפר ולהעצים את הקריירות, מאמציהם והשפעתם.

למידע נוסף בקרו בכתובת https://cliburnagency.com/

"סוכנות Cliburn היא הרחבה משכנעת של המותג וההשפעה של Cliburn. המשימה העיקרית שלנו היא לתמוך באמנים ולקדם באופן מתמיד את המוזיקה הקלאסית. ניהול וקידום מוזיקאים יוצאי דופן - במיוחד כאלה עם להט ומסירות ספציפיים להרחבת קהלים ולשבירת מחסומים - הוא הצעד הבא במימוש משימה זו. באמצעות תוכנית חדשה זו, Cliburn מפתחת דרך עוצמתית נוספת לפגוש את הרגע ולמצוא דרכים חדשות להרחיב את טווח ההגעה של המוזיקה הקלאסית כמקור למשותף וחוויה משותפת בעולם של ימינו."
- ז'אק מרקיז, נשיא ומנכ"ל

id.title: Agensi Cliburn
id.description:
Cliburn Agency adalah firma butik layanan lengkap yang menawarkan manajemen umum komprehensif, pemesanan konser, manajemen proyek, serta layanan publisitas dan branding kepada sekelompok instrumentalis terpilih yang sedang naik daun dan mapan—piano dan seterusnya—yang kualitas artistiknya yang tinggi diimbangi oleh visi untuk memajukan bidang musik klasik.

Daftar artis Cliburn Agency terdiri dari Anderson & Roe Piano Duo (@andersonroe); Greg Anderson, piano (@gregandersonpiano); Peter Dugan, piano (@peterdugan9983); Fei-Fei, piano (@feifeipianist); Bridget Kibbey, harpa (@bridgetkibbey); Joshua Roman, cello (@JoshuaRomanCello); dan Clayton Stephenson, piano (@Claytonplayspiano). Dari program dan proyek yang menarik hingga konser alternatif dan keterlibatan komunitas, para musisi tur dalam daftar Agensi berdedikasi pada koneksi dan kreativitas—dan mereka bermitra dengan Cliburn untuk meningkatkan dan memperbesar karier, upaya, dan dampak mereka.

Pelajari lebih lanjut di https://cliburnagency.com/

“Agensi Cliburn merupakan perluasan yang menarik dari merek dan dampak Cliburn. Misi utama kami adalah mendukung para seniman dan terus memajukan musik klasik. Manajemen dan promosi musisi-musisi luar biasa—terutama mereka yang memiliki semangat dan dedikasi khusus untuk memperluas jangkauan audiens dan mendobrak batasan—adalah langkah selanjutnya dalam mewujudkan misi tersebut. Melalui program baru ini, Cliburn mengembangkan cara ampuh lainnya untuk menghadapi momen dan menemukan cara baru untuk memperluas jangkauan musik klasik sebagai sumber kesamaan dan pengalaman bersama di dunia saat ini.”
– Jacques Marquis, Presiden & CEO

ja.title: クライバーン・エージェンシー
ja.description:
クライバーン・エージェンシーは、ピアノをはじめ、幅広いジャンルの新進気鋭からベテランまで、選りすぐりの楽器奏者たちに、総合的なゼネラル・マネジメント、コンサート予約、プロジェクトマネジメント、広報・ブランディングサービスを提供する、フルサービスのブティック・カンパニーです。彼らは高い芸術的才能と、クラシック音楽界を前進させるというビジョンを持ち合わせています。

クライバーン・エージェンシーのメンバーは、アンダーソン＆ロー・ピアノ・デュオ（@andersonroe）、グレッグ・アンダーソン（ピアノ）（@gregandersonpiano）、ピーター・デュガン（ピアノ）（@peterdugan9983）、フェイフェイ（ピアノ）（@feifeipianist）、ブリジット・キビー（ハープ）（@bridgetkibbey）、ジョシュア・ローマン（チェロ）（@JoshuaRomanCello）、そしてクレイトン・ステファンソン（ピアノ）（@Claytonplayspiano）です。魅力的なプログラムやプロジェクトから、オルタナティブ・コンサートや地域活動まで、エージェンシーに所属するツアー・ミュージシャンたちは、繋がりと創造性に情熱を注いでいます。そして、クライバーン・エージェンシーと提携することで、キャリア、活動、そして社会への影響力をさらに高め、拡大しています。

詳しくは https://cliburnagency.com/ をご覧ください。

「クライバーン・エージェンシーは、クライバーンのブランドと影響力を魅力的に拡大するものです。私たちの核となる使命は、アーティストを支援し、クラシック音楽を継続的に発展させることです。特に、聴衆の拡大と障壁の打破に特別な情熱と献身を持つ、卓越した音楽家のマネジメントとプロモーションは、この使命を実現するための次のステップです。この新しいプログラムを通じて、クライバーンは、現代社会において、共通性と共有体験の源泉として、クラシック音楽の影響力を拡大するための新たな強力な方法を開発しています。」
– ジャック・マーキス 社長兼CEO

bn.title: ক্লাইবার্ন এজেন্সি
bn.description:
ক্লাইবার্ন এজেন্সি একটি পূর্ণাঙ্গ পরিষেবা প্রদানকারী বুটিক ফার্ম যা পিয়ানো এবং তার বাইরের উদীয়মান এবং প্রতিষ্ঠিত বাদ্যযন্ত্রবাদকদের একটি নির্বাচিত গোষ্ঠীকে ব্যাপক সাধারণ ব্যবস্থাপনা, কনসার্ট বুকিং, প্রকল্প ব্যবস্থাপনা এবং প্রচার এবং ব্র্যান্ডিং পরিষেবা প্রদান করে - যাদের উচ্চ শৈল্পিক ক্ষমতা শাস্ত্রীয় সঙ্গীতের ক্ষেত্রকে এগিয়ে নিয়ে যাওয়ার দৃষ্টিভঙ্গির সাথে মিলে যায়।

ক্লাইবার্ন এজেন্সি রোস্টারে রয়েছেন অ্যান্ডারসন এবং রো পিয়ানো জুটি (@andersonroe); গ্রেগ অ্যান্ডারসন, পিয়ানো (@gregandersonpiano); পিটার ডুগান, পিয়ানো (@peterdugan9983); ফেই-ফেই, পিয়ানো (@feifeipianist); ব্রিজেট কিবে, হার্প (@bridgetkibbey); জোশুয়া রোমান, সেলো (@JoshuaRomanCello); এবং ক্লেটন স্টিফেনসন, পিয়ানো (@Claytonplayspiano)। আকর্ষণীয় প্রোগ্রামিং এবং প্রকল্প থেকে শুরু করে বিকল্প কনসার্ট এবং সম্প্রদায়ের সম্পৃক্ততা পর্যন্ত, এজেন্সি রোস্টারের ভ্রমণকারী সঙ্গীতশিল্পীরা সংযোগ এবং সৃজনশীলতার প্রতি নিবেদিতপ্রাণ - এবং তারা তাদের ক্যারিয়ার, প্রচেষ্টা এবং প্রভাবকে উন্নত এবং বিবর্ধিত করার জন্য ক্লাইবার্নের সাথে অংশীদারিত্ব করছে।

https://cliburnagency.com/ এ আরও জানুন

“ক্লিবার্ন এজেন্সি হল ক্লিবার্নের ব্র্যান্ড এবং প্রভাবের একটি আকর্ষণীয় সম্প্রসারণ। আমাদের মূল লক্ষ্য হল শিল্পীদের সমর্থন করা এবং ক্রমাগত ধ্রুপদী সঙ্গীতকে এগিয়ে নেওয়া। ব্যতিক্রমী সঙ্গীতজ্ঞদের ব্যবস্থাপনা এবং প্রচার - বিশেষ করে যাদের শ্রোতাদের সম্প্রসারণ এবং বাধা ভেঙে ফেলার জন্য নির্দিষ্ট উৎসাহ এবং নিষ্ঠা রয়েছে - সেই লক্ষ্য বাস্তবায়নের পরবর্তী পদক্ষেপ। এই নতুন প্রোগ্রামের মাধ্যমে, ক্লিবার্ন আজকের বিশ্বে সাধারণতা এবং ভাগ করা অভিজ্ঞতার উৎস হিসেবে ধ্রুপদী সঙ্গীতের নাগাল প্রসারিত করার এবং নতুন উপায় খুঁজে বের করার আরেকটি শক্তিশালী উপায় তৈরি করে।”
– জ্যাক মার্কুইস, সভাপতি এবং প্রধান নির্বাহী কর্মকর্তা

ta.title: கிளிபர்ன் ஏஜென்சி
ta.description:
கிளிபர்ன் ஏஜென்சி என்பது ஒரு முழு சேவை பூட்டிக் நிறுவனமாகும், இது பியானோ மற்றும் அதற்கு அப்பால் வளர்ந்து வரும் மற்றும் நிறுவப்பட்ட இசைக்கருவி கலைஞர்களின் தேர்ந்தெடுக்கப்பட்ட குழுவிற்கு விரிவான பொது மேலாண்மை, இசை நிகழ்ச்சி முன்பதிவு, திட்ட மேலாண்மை மற்றும் விளம்பரம் மற்றும் பிராண்டிங் சேவைகளை வழங்குகிறது - அவர்களின் உயர் கலைத் திறன் பாரம்பரிய இசைத் துறையை முன்னோக்கி நகர்த்துவதற்கான ஒரு தொலைநோக்குப் பார்வையுடன் பொருந்துகிறது.

கிளிபர்ன் ஏஜென்சி பட்டியலில் ஆண்டர்சன் & ரோ பியானோ டியோ (@andersonroe); கிரெக் ஆண்டர்சன், பியானோ (@gregandersonpiano) ; பீட்டர் டுகன், பியானோ (@peterdugan9983) ; ஃபீ-ஃபீ, பியானோ (@feefeipianist) ; பிரிட்ஜெட் கிபே, ஹார்ப் (@bridgetkibbey); ஜோசுவா ரோமன், செல்லோ (@JoshuaRomanCello) ; மற்றும் கிளேட்டன் ஸ்டீபன்சன், பியானோ (@Claytonplayspiano) ஆகியோர் உள்ளனர். சுவாரஸ்யமான நிகழ்ச்சிகள் மற்றும் திட்டங்கள் முதல் மாற்று இசை நிகழ்ச்சிகள் மற்றும் சமூக ஈடுபாடு வரை, ஏஜென்சி பட்டியலின் சுற்றுலா இசைக்கலைஞர்கள் இணைப்பு மற்றும் படைப்பாற்றலுக்கு அர்ப்பணித்துள்ளனர் - மேலும் அவர்கள் தங்கள் தொழில், முயற்சிகள் மற்றும் தாக்கத்தை மேம்படுத்தவும் பெரிதாக்கவும் கிளிபர்னுடன் கூட்டு சேர்ந்துள்ளனர்.

மேலும் அறிக https://cliburnagency.com/

“கிளிபர்ன் ஏஜென்சி என்பது கிளிபர்னின் பிராண்ட் மற்றும் தாக்கத்தின் ஒரு கட்டாய விரிவாக்கமாகும். கலைஞர்களை ஆதரிப்பதும், பாரம்பரிய இசையை தொடர்ந்து முன்னேற்றுவதும் எங்கள் முக்கிய நோக்கம். விதிவிலக்கான இசைக்கலைஞர்களை - குறிப்பாக பார்வையாளர்களை விரிவுபடுத்துவதற்கும் தடைகளை உடைப்பதற்கும் ஒரு குறிப்பிட்ட ஆர்வமும் அர்ப்பணிப்பும் கொண்டவர்களை - நிர்வகிப்பதும் ஊக்குவிப்பதும் அந்த நோக்கத்தை நிறைவேற்றுவதற்கான அடுத்த படியாகும். இந்த புதிய திட்டத்தின் மூலம், இன்றைய உலகில் பொதுவான தன்மை மற்றும் பகிரப்பட்ட அனுபவத்தின் ஆதாரமாக கிளாசிக்கல் இசையின் வரம்பை விரிவுபடுத்துவதற்கான புதிய வழிகளைக் கண்டறிய கிளிபர்ன் மற்றொரு சக்திவாய்ந்த வழியை உருவாக்குகிறது.”
– ஜாக் மார்க்விஸ், தலைவர் மற்றும் தலைமை நிர்வாக அதிகாரி

nl-NL.title: Het Cliburn-agentschap
nl-NL.description:
Cliburn Agency is een full-service boutiquebureau dat uitgebreide diensten aanbiedt op het gebied van algemeen management, concertboekingen, projectmanagement, publiciteit en branding aan een selecte groep opkomende en gevestigde instrumentalisten – zowel piano als andere – wiens hoge artistieke kaliber wordt geëvenaard door een visie om de klassieke muziek vooruit te helpen.

Het team van Cliburn Agency bestaat uit Anderson & Roe Piano Duo (@andersonroe); Greg Anderson, piano (@gregandersonpiano); Peter Dugan, piano (@peterdugan9983); Fei-Fei, piano (@feifeipianist); Bridget Kibbey, harp (@bridgetkibbey); Joshua Roman, cello (@JoshuaRomanCello); en Clayton Stephenson, piano (@Claytonplayspiano). Van intrigerende programmering en projecten tot alternatieve concerten en maatschappelijke betrokkenheid: de tourende muzikanten van het Agency-team zetten zich in voor verbinding en creativiteit – en ze werken samen met Cliburn om hun carrières, inspanningen en impact te versterken en te vergroten.

Meer informatie vindt u op https://cliburnagency.com/

"De Cliburn Agency is een overtuigende uitbreiding van het merk en de impact van Cliburn. Onze kernmissie is het ondersteunen van artiesten en het continu bevorderen van klassieke muziek. Het managen en promoten van uitzonderlijke muzikanten – met name zij met een specifieke passie en toewijding om hun publiek te vergroten en barrières te slechten – is de volgende stap in het realiseren van die missie. Met dit nieuwe programma ontwikkelt Cliburn een nieuwe krachtige manier om het moment te beleven en nieuwe manieren te vinden om het bereik van klassieke muziek als bron van gemeenschappelijkheid en gedeelde ervaring in de wereld van vandaag te vergroten."
– Jacques Marquis, president & CEO

pl.title: Agencja Cliburn
pl.description:
Agencja Cliburn to butikowa firma oferująca pełen zakres usług, która oferuje kompleksowe usługi zarządzania ogólnego, rezerwacji koncertów, zarządzania projektami oraz usługi z zakresu reklamy i budowania marki dla wybranej grupy wschodzących i uznanych instrumentalistów – zarówno grających na fortepianie, jak i nie tylko – których wysoki poziom artystyczny idzie w parze z wizją rozwoju muzyki klasycznej.

W skład agencji Cliburn wchodzą: Anderson & Roe Piano Duo (@andersonroe); Greg Anderson, fortepian (@gregandersonpiano); Peter Dugan, fortepian (@peterdugan9983); Fei-Fei, fortepian (@feifeipianist); Bridget Kibbey, harfa (@bridgetkibbey); Joshua Roman, wiolonczela (@JoshuaRomanCello); oraz Clayton Stephenson, fortepian (@Claytonplayspiano). Od intrygujących programów i projektów, po alternatywne koncerty i zaangażowanie społeczne, muzycy z listy Agencji są oddani budowaniu więzi i kreatywności – i współpracują z Cliburn, aby rozwijać i zwiększać swoje kariery, wysiłki i wpływ.

Dowiedz się więcej na stronie https://cliburnagency.com/

„Agencja Cliburn to fascynujące rozszerzenie marki i wpływu Cliburn. Naszą główną misją jest wspieranie artystów i ciągłe rozwijanie muzyki klasycznej. Zarządzanie i promocja wyjątkowych muzyków – szczególnie tych, którzy z pasją i oddaniem dążą do poszerzania grona odbiorców i przełamywania barier – to kolejny krok w realizacji tej misji. Dzięki temu nowemu programowi Cliburn rozwija kolejny, skuteczny sposób na stawienie czoła chwili i znalezienie nowych sposobów na poszerzenie zasięgu muzyki klasycznej jako źródła wspólnoty i wspólnych doświadczeń we współczesnym świecie”.
– Jacques Marquis, prezes i dyrektor generalny

es-US.title: La Agencia Cliburn
es-US.description:
La Agencia Cliburn es una firma boutique de servicios integrales que ofrece gestión general, reserva de conciertos, gestión de proyectos, publicidad y branding a un selecto grupo de instrumentistas emergentes y consolidados, tanto de piano como de otras disciplinas, cuyo alto calibre artístico se complementa con una visión para impulsar el campo de la música clásica.

La plantilla de la Agencia Cliburn está compuesta por Anderson & Roe Piano Duo (@andersonroe); Greg Anderson, piano (@gregandersonpiano); Peter Dugan, piano (@peterdugan9983); Fei-Fei, piano (@feifeipianist); Bridget Kibbey, arpa (@bridgetkibbey); Joshua Roman, violonchelo (@JoshuaRomanCello); y Clayton Stephenson, piano (@Claytonplayspiano). Desde una programación y proyectos fascinantes hasta conciertos alternativos y participación comunitaria, los músicos de gira de la Agencia se dedican a la conexión y la creatividad, y colaboran con la Agencia Cliburn para potenciar y ampliar sus carreras, esfuerzos e impacto. Más información en https://cliburnagency.com/

“La Agencia Cliburn representa una expansión convincente de la marca y el impacto de Cliburn. Nuestra misión principal es apoyar a los artistas y promover continuamente la música clásica. La gestión y promoción de músicos excepcionales, en particular de aquellos con un fervor y una dedicación específicos para ampliar audiencias y romper barreras, es el siguiente paso para lograr esta misión. A través de este nuevo programa, Cliburn desarrolla otra forma poderosa de conectar con el momento y encontrar nuevas maneras de expandir el alcance de la música clásica como fuente de encuentro y experiencias compartidas en el mundo actual.”
– Jacques Marquis, presidente y director ejecutivo

hi.title: क्लिबर्न एजेंसी
hi.description:
क्लिबर्न एजेंसी एक पूर्ण-सेवा बुटीक फर्म है जो उभरते और स्थापित वाद्यवादकों—पियानो और उससे आगे—के चुनिंदा समूह को व्यापक सामान्य प्रबंधन, संगीत कार्यक्रम बुकिंग, परियोजना प्रबंधन, और प्रचार एवं ब्रांडिंग सेवाएँ प्रदान करती है, जिनकी उच्च कलात्मक क्षमता शास्त्रीय संगीत के क्षेत्र को आगे बढ़ाने के दृष्टिकोण से मेल खाती है।

क्लिबर्न एजेंसी की सूची में एंडरसन और रो पियानो डुओ (@andersonroe); ग्रेग एंडरसन, पियानो (@gregandersonpiano); पीटर डुगन, पियानो (@peterdugan9983); फी-फी, पियानो (@feifeipianist); ब्रिजेट किब्बी, वीणा (@bridgetkibbey); जोशुआ रोमन, सेलो (@JoshuaRomanCello); और क्लेटन स्टीफेंसन, पियानो (@Claytonplayspiano) शामिल हैं। दिलचस्प कार्यक्रमों और परियोजनाओं से लेकर वैकल्पिक संगीत कार्यक्रमों और सामुदायिक जुड़ाव तक, एजेंसी के भ्रमणशील संगीतकार जुड़ाव और रचनात्मकता के लिए समर्पित हैं—और वे अपने करियर, प्रयासों और प्रभाव को बढ़ाने और बढ़ाने के लिए क्लिबर्न के साथ साझेदारी कर रहे हैं।

अधिक जानकारी के लिए https://cliburnagency.com/ पर जाएँ

“क्लिबर्न एजेंसी, क्लिबर्न के ब्रांड और प्रभाव का एक आकर्षक विस्तार है। हमारा मुख्य मिशन कलाकारों का समर्थन करना और शास्त्रीय संगीत को निरंतर आगे बढ़ाना है। असाधारण संगीतकारों का प्रबंधन और प्रचार—विशेषकर वे जो दर्शकों का विस्तार करने और बाधाओं को तोड़ने के लिए विशिष्ट उत्साह और समर्पण रखते हैं—उस मिशन को साकार करने की दिशा में अगला कदम है। इस नए कार्यक्रम के माध्यम से, क्लिबर्न वर्तमान समय का सामना करने और आज की दुनिया में समानता और साझा अनुभव के स्रोत के रूप में शास्त्रीय संगीत की पहुँच का विस्तार करने के नए तरीके खोजने का एक और शक्तिशाली तरीका विकसित करता है।”
- जैक्स मार्क्विस, अध्यक्ष और सीईओ

snippet.title: Vitaly Starikov: Cliburn 2025 SCHUMANN Symphonic Etudes, op. 13
snippet.description:
Seventeenth Van Cliburn International Piano Competition
Quarterfinal Round Recital
May 25, 2025
Van Cliburn Concert Hall at TCU

Vitaly Starikov - SILVER MEDALIST
Israel/Russia
Age 30

SCHUMANN Symphonic Etudes, op. 13

About Vitaly

Russian/Israeli pianist Vitaly Starikov has found distinction with “raw, deeply felt, and powerful” (La Scena) performances, while having an unassuming onstage presence and a “willingness less to play at the audience than to draw [them] into musical intimacies” (Dallas Morning News). His bold approach won him silver at the 2025 Van Cliburn International Piano Competition and the admiration of fans around the globe. Vitaly’s perspective on music is manifested in his repertoire: he presents music that reflects not only tradition, but also contemporary life, striving to offer new perspectives on familiar music and introduce lesser-known pieces to wider audiences. His Cliburn performance of Bartok’s Second Piano Concerto electrified the room, with a La Scena reviewer noting that “he understood this music, and gave an impactful, lively, and gripping interpretation on all levels: emotionally, architecturally, and in terms of his sound palette.”

Recital and chamber music appearances have taken him around the world, notably to Austria, Australia, Slovakia, Israel, Cyprus, Italy, France, Belgium, and Malaysia, with highlights including Sydney Opera House, Queen Elisabeth Hall, and the Great Hall of the Moscow Conservatory. He has performed with the Antwerp and Belgian National Orchestras, Sydney Symphony Orchestra, Belarusian State Symphony Orchestra, and St. Petersburg Symphony, and toured with the Orchestre national de Metz Grand Est. This inaugural Cliburn season takes him to the Bravo! Vail and Sunriver Music Festivals; Colorado Springs Philharmonic, and Pacific, Topeka, and Springfield Symphony Orchestras, and in recitals throughout the United States.

Born into a family of musicians, Vitaly’s journey started when his parents enrolled him to sing in a children’s music group at age 3, and he went on to Ural Musical School for Gifted Children in his native Yekaterinburg at 7. He made his concerto debut at age 10 with the Ural State Russian Folk Orchestra, and his recital debut three years later, in the small hall of the Ural Special Music School. It was at 14 that he committed his life to music. His “dream came true” when he began studying with Vera Gornostayeva, one of the world’s most venerated teachers, at the Moscow Tchaikovsky Conservatory. He went on to earn his bachelor’s degree at the Conservatory and then his master’s degree, under the tutelage of Eliso Virsaladze. He’s now at the Yale School of Music, pursuing an artist diploma under Boris Berman.

snippet.title: 2025 Cliburn Backstage: Carter Johnson, Ravel Piano Concerto for the Left Hand
snippet.description:
Cliburn Backstage with Greg Anderson (‪@gregandersonpiano)
Interviews, curation, and editing by Greg Anderson

Seventeenth Van Cliburn International Piano Competition
May 21–June 7, 2025

Watch Carter's Ravel Piano Concerto for the Left Hand: https://youtu.be/gwaEeOTXhuQ

Carter Johnson, Canada/United States, 28
https://cliburn.org/competitions/2025-cliburn-competition/2025-competitors/carter-johnson

About Carter
Carter Johnson only ever remembers wanting to become a concert pianist since his grandmother encouraged him toward the instrument when he was 5. Growing up on Vancouver Island, he studied with Shelley Roberts for 12 years before attending the University of British Columbia, where he completed a bachelor’s under Mark Anderson. He moved to the United States in 2019 to study with Joseph Kalichstein and Matti Raekallio at The Juilliard School (master’s) and has spent the last four years in New Haven, living with his wife and two children while attending the Yale School of Music under the tutelage of Wei-Yi Yang (master’s and now doctorate studies).  

The silver medalist of the 2024 Gina Bachauer International Piano Competition, he has performed with the Montréal Symphony Orchestra, Polish National Radio Symphony Orchestra, Orchestre Métropolitain, Utah Symphony, Poznań Philharmonic Orchestra, Victoria Symphony Orchestra, and Orchestra of the Americas, and his playing has been broadcasted by CBC Radio and medici.tv. Venue highlights include the Maison Symphonique, Chan Centre for the Performing Arts, Kaufmann Concert Hall at the 92nd Street Y, Shenzhen Concert Hall, Salle Bourgie, and Warsaw National Philharmonic Hall. 

Carter has a particular interest in bringing light to lesser-explored parts of the repertory, most recently championing a collection of works by nearly forgotten Polish composers. He’s an experienced vocal coach, is enthusiastic about languages, and has also studied oboe, voice, and harpsichord. Trained in elocution as a teenager, he holds an ATCL with distinction in speech and drama from Trinity College London, which serves him well in recital: he loves speaking with audiences to bring them further into the music and its story. He also finds great inspiration outside of classical music—in his family, film, nature, food, and non-classical artists like Björk and Brian Eno, whom he says help him to think outside the box.

About Angel
Angel Stanislav Wang was born into a family of musicians in Los Angeles. He joined Natalia Trull’s studio at Central Music School and then the Moscow Tchaikovsky Conservatory in 2020, where he continues to study today. 

A winner of more than 35 international competitions (and a silver medal at the 2023 Tchaikovsky), Angel regularly concertizes in the United States, Germany, Russia, Switzerland, Austria, Spain, Italy, Croatia; he’s performed at Carnegie Hall, Musikverein (Vienna, Austria), the Great, Small, and Rachmaninov Halls of the Moscow Conservatory, Concert Halls of the Mariinsky Theatre (St. Petersburg), and Tchaikovsky Concert Hall (Moscow). The 22-year-old loves traveling to different countries: “Whenever I have the chance, I visit different museums, theatres, and art exhibitions. It is interesting to experience the different cultures, mentalities, and ideas, as well as interests, of other people.”

snippet.description:
Cliburn Backstage with Greg Anderson (‪ @gregandersonpiano  )
Interviews, curation, and editing by Greg Anderson

Seventeenth Van Cliburn International Piano Competition
May 21–June 7, 2025

Watch Philipp's Prokofiev Piano Concerto No. 2: https://youtu.be/IdnTOpFOxfk

Philipp Lynov, Russia, 26
https://cliburn.org/competitions/2025-cliburn-competition/2025-competitors/philipp-lynov

About Philipp
Philipp Lynov saw a piano for the first time when he was in kindergarten. The moment left such a lasting impression on him that he credits it—the fascination of owning a piano and childhood curiosity—with his start in music. He started learning at the age of 6 as “simply a source of joy,” then earned a spot at the Central Music School at the Moscow Tchaikovsky Conservatory at the age of 14, studying with Natalia Bogdanova. He went on to complete his bachelor’s there as well, under Eliso Virsaladze. He then moved to Germany, where he's studied with Claudio Martinez Mehner and Nina Tichman at the Hochschule für Musik und Tanz Köln since 2022.  

Philipp has won first prizes at international competitions, including Xiamen (China), Takamatsu (Japan), and Paderewski (Poland), among others. Concerts have taken him around the globe—to Russia, Germany, Austria, Poland, Spain, Italy, Israel, Switzerland, Australia, and Japan—with highlights including his 2023 debut in the Main Auditorium of the Berlin Philharmonic with the Sinfonieorchester Berlin. When it comes to engaging audiences, he says: “I believe that every person possesses their own unique brilliance. To captivate audiences with music, it’s essential to communicate something meaningful—something that, while not always easy to define, resonates deeply.”

snippet.description:

Watch Evren's Beethoven Piano Concerto No. 4: https://youtu.be/7U2POEqe6Ow

Evren Ozel, United States, 36
https://cliburn.org/competitions/2025-cliburn-competition/2025-competitors/evren-ozel

About Evren
Evren Ozel’s start in piano was very simple: at the age of 3, he was asked if he wanted to take lessons, and he said yes. Right away, these lessons were his favorite part of the week. “If I got in trouble with my mom, the threat that would set me straight was the threat of taking me out of piano lessons.” After his first international piano competition when he was 14, he was inspired to pursue music professionally. “The colleagues I met who shared an interest in playing music, and the immense repertoire that I learned about over those two weeks helped me understand what an incredibly deep and enriching world that pianists live in.” He’s attended the New England Conservatory of Music in Boston since 2017, studying with Wha Kyung Byun and earning his bachelor’s, master’s, and artist diploma; he is now part of the NEC Institute for Concert Artists. 

Evren is the recipient of 2023 Avery Fisher and 2022 Salon de Virtuosi Career Grants, and a laureate of the Cleveland, Dublin, and Cooper International Piano Competitions. He has been represented by Concert Artists Guild since 2021 as a winner of their Victor Elmaleh Competition. Since his debut with the Minnesota Orchestra at age 11, he has been a featured soloist with the Cleveland Orchestra, Jacksonville Symphony, and Boston Pops Orchestra. He’s performed recitals at La Jolla Music Society, Capital Region Classical, Cal Performances, Schubert Club, Chopin Society of Minnesota, and The Gilmore. His first album of Mozart Concertos with the ORF Radio Symphony of Vienna and conductor Howard Griffiths will be released this year on Alpha Classics. An active chamber musician, he performs alongside artists including Stella Chen, Zlatomir Fung, Paul Huang, and Kim Kashkashian. He spent four summers at the Marlboro Festival and is currently a 2024–2027 Bowers Program Artist for the Chamber Music Society of Lincoln Center.

snippet.description:
Cliburn Backstage with Greg Anderson ( ‪@gregandersonpiano )
Interviews, curation, and editing by Greg Anderson

Seventeenth Van Cliburn International Piano Competition
May 21–June 7, 2025

Watch Vitaly's Schumann Piano Concerto: https://youtu.be/v9SuqS8ABGM

Vitaly Starikov, Israel/Russia, 30
https://cliburn.org/competitions/2025-cliburn-competition/2025-competitors/vitaly-starikov

About Vitaly
Born into a family of musicians, Vitaly Starikov’s journey started when his parents enrolled him to sing in a children’s music group at age 3, and he went on to Ural Musical School for Gifted Children in his native Yekaterinburg at 7. He made his concerto debut at age 10 with the Ural State Russian Folk Orchestra, and his recital debut three years later, in the small hall of the Ural Special Music School. It was at 14 that he committed his life to music. His “dream came true” when he began studying with Vera Gornostayeva, one of the world’s most venerated teachers, at the Moscow Tchaikovsky Conservatory. At that time, her student, Vadym Kholodenko, had just won the 2013 Cliburn Competition, which greatly inspired Vitaly: “and it was then that the thought was born to someday participate in this competition.” He went on to earn his bachelor’s degree at the Conservatory and then his master’s degree, under the tutelage of Eliso Virsaladze. He’s now at the Yale School of Music, pursuing an artist diploma under Boris Berman and is a laureate of the Queen Elisabeth and Sydney International Competitions.

Recital and chamber music appearances have taken him around the world, notably to Austria, Australia, Slovakia, Israel, Cyprus, Italy, France, Belgium, and Malaysia, with highlights including Sydney Opera House, Queen Elisabeth Hall, and the Great Hall of the Moscow Conservatory. He has performed with the Antwerp and Belgian National Orchestras, Sydney Symphony Orchestra, Belarusian State Symphony Orchestra, and St. Petersburg Symphony, and toured with the Orchestre national de Metz Grand Est. He holds a strong commitment to new music and has won accolades for his performances of it, including at the Queen Elisabeth (Belgium), Jaen (Spain), and Taneyev (Russia) international competitions. “I want to present works that reflect not only tradition but also contemporary life, offering new perspectives on familiar music and introducing lesser-known pieces to wider audiences.”

snippet.title: 2025 Cliburn Backstage: Aristo Sham, Brahms Piano Concerto No. 2
snippet.description:
Cliburn Backstage with Greg Anderson (‪ @gregandersonpiano )
Interviews, curation, and editing by Greg Anderson


Seventeenth Van Cliburn International Piano Competition
May 21–June 7, 2025

Watch Aristo's Brahms Concerto here: https://youtu.be/Awa-vaHVF2E

Aristo Sham, Hong Kong China, 29
https://cliburn.org/competitions/2025-cliburn-competition/2025-competitors/aristo-sham


About Aristo
Aristo Sham’s mother taught piano in their Hong Kong home, so he says: “I was enveloped in the environment of the piano even before I was born.” His parents recall his immense curiosity towards the instrument when he was a toddler and started him in lessons (with another teacher) when he was 3. At the age of 10, he began competing and concertizing. But he also went to regular schools, never making the conscious decision of focusing solely on the piano or his other studies; this made the dual degree program at Harvard and the New England Conservatory a perfect fit when he went to college. He finished his Bachelor of Arts at Harvard in 2019 and master’s at NEC under Victor Rosenbaum in 2020. He then went to the Ingesund School of Music in Sweden to study with Julia Mustonen-Dahlkvist before returning to the States to earn an artist diploma at The Juilliard School with Robert McDonald and Orli Shaham. 

Aristo was featured in the documentary The World’s Greatest Musical Prodigies on Channel 4 (UK) and has performed for royalty, including King Charles. He’s a laureate of international competitions, with first-prize wins at Ettlingen, Gina Bachauer, and Monte Carlo Music Masters, and is on the Young Concert Artists roster. He has concertized across Asia, Europe, and the United States, with major highlights including the London Symphony Orchestra under Sir Simon Rattle, Hong Kong Philharmonic Orchestra under Edo de Waart, English Chamber Orchestra under the late Sir Raymond Leppard, Orchestre de Chambre de Lausanne, and Minnesota Orchestra. 

His interests remain varied as he pursues a career as a pianist and lists among them travel, aviation, gastronomy, oenology, and language. “I am incredibly fortunate to have enjoyed vast experiences in life and an extremely varied education, both in music and otherwise; I hope to draw from my expressive, emotional and intellectual capacity, to project an artistic voice and create unique experiences that resonate with our audiences of today.”

Interviews, curation, and editing by Greg Anderson

Aristo Sham, Hong Kong China, 29
https://cliburn.org/competitions/2025-cliburn-competition/2025-competitors/aristo-sham


About Aristo
Aristo Sham’s mother taught piano in their Hong Kong home, so he says: “I was enveloped in the environment of the piano even before I was born.” His parents recall his immense curiosity towards the instrument when he was a toddler and started him in lessons (with another teacher) when he was 3. At the age of 10, he began competing and concertizing. But he also went to regular schools, never making the conscious decision of focusing solely on the piano or his other studies; this made the dual degree program at Harvard and the New England Conservatory a perfect fit when he went to college. He finished his Bachelor of Arts at Harvard in 2019 and master’s at NEC under Victor Rosenbaum in 2020. He then went to the Ingesund School of Music in Sweden to study with Julia Mustonen-Dahlkvist before returning to the States to earn an artist diploma at The Juilliard School with Robert McDonald and Orli Shaham. 

Aristo was featured in the documentary The World’s Greatest Musical Prodigies on Channel 4 (UK) and has performed for royalty, including King Charles. He’s a laureate of international competitions, with first-prize wins at Ettlingen, Gina Bachauer, and Monte Carlo Music Masters, and is on the Young Concert Artists roster. He has concertized across Asia, Europe, and the United States, with major highlights including the London Symphony Orchestra under Sir Simon Rattle, Hong Kong Philharmonic Orchestra under Edo de Waart, English Chamber Orchestra under the late Sir Raymond Leppard, Orchestre de Chambre de Lausanne, and Minnesota Orchestra. 

His interests remain varied as he pursues a career as a pianist and lists among them travel, aviation, gastronomy, oenology, and language. “I am incredibly fortunate to have enjoyed vast experiences in life and an extremely varied education, both in music and otherwise; I hope to draw from my expressive, emotional and intellectual capacity, to project an artistic voice and create unique experiences that resonate with our audiences of today.”

snippet.description:
Seventeenth Van Cliburn International Piano Competition
Final Round Concerto 2
June 6, 2025
Bass Performance Hall

Evren Ozel
United States
Age 26

Fort Worth Symphony Orchestra
Marin Alsop, conductor

BEETHOVEN Piano Concerto No. 4 in G Major, op. 58

About Evren
Evren Ozel’s start in piano was very simple: at the age of 3, he was asked if he wanted to take lessons, and he said yes. Right away, these lessons were his favorite part of the week. “If I got in trouble with my mom, the threat that would set me straight was the threat of taking me out of piano lessons.” After his first international piano competition when he was 14, he was inspired to pursue music professionally. “The colleagues I met who shared an interest in playing music, and the immense repertoire that I learned about over those two weeks helped me understand what an incredibly deep and enriching world that pianists live in.” He’s attended the New England Conservatory of Music in Boston since 2017, studying with Wha Kyung Byun and earning his bachelor’s, master’s, and artist diploma; he is now part of the NEC Institute for Concert Artists. 

Evren is the recipient of 2023 Avery Fisher and 2022 Salon de Virtuosi Career Grants, and a laureate of the Cleveland, Dublin, and Cooper International Piano Competitions. He has been represented by Concert Artists Guild since 2021 as a winner of their Victor Elmaleh Competition. Since his debut with the Minnesota Orchestra at age 11, he has been a featured soloist with the Cleveland Orchestra, Jacksonville Symphony, and Boston Pops Orchestra. He’s performed recitals at La Jolla Music Society, Capital Region Classical, Cal Performances, Schubert Club, Chopin Society of Minnesota, and The Gilmore. His first album of Mozart Concertos with the ORF Radio Symphony of Vienna and conductor Howard Griffiths will be released this year on Alpha Classics. An active chamber musician, he performs alongside artists including Stella Chen, Zlatomir Fung, Paul Huang, and Kim Kashkashian. He spent four summers at the Marlboro Festival and is currently a 2024–2027 Bowers Program Artist for the Chamber Music Society of Lincoln Center.

Fort Worth Symphony Orchestra
Marin Alsop, conductor

BEETHOVEN Piano Concerto No. 4 in G Major, op. 58

About Evren
Evren Ozel’s start in piano was very simple: at the age of 3, he was asked if he wanted to take lessons, and he said yes. Right away, these lessons were his favorite part of the week. “If I got in trouble with my mom, the threat that would set me straight was the threat of taking me out of piano lessons.” After his first international piano competition when he was 14, he was inspired to pursue music professionally. “The colleagues I met who shared an interest in playing music, and the immense repertoire that I learned about over those two weeks helped me understand what an incredibly deep and enriching world that pianists live in.” He’s attended the New England Conservatory of Music in Boston since 2017, studying with Wha Kyung Byun and earning his bachelor’s, master’s, and artist diploma; he is now part of the NEC Institute for Concert Artists. 

Evren is the recipient of 2023 Avery Fisher and 2022 Salon de Virtuosi Career Grants, and a laureate of the Cleveland, Dublin, and Cooper International Piano Competitions. He has been represented by Concert Artists Guild since 2021 as a winner of their Victor Elmaleh Competition. Since his debut with the Minnesota Orchestra at age 11, he has been a featured soloist with the Cleveland Orchestra, Jacksonville Symphony, and Boston Pops Orchestra. He’s performed recitals at La Jolla Music Society, Capital Region Classical, Cal Performances, Schubert Club, Chopin Society of Minnesota, and The Gilmore. His first album of Mozart Concertos with the ORF Radio Symphony of Vienna and conductor Howard Griffiths will be released this year on Alpha Classics. An active chamber musician, he performs alongside artists including Stella Chen, Zlatomir Fung, Paul Huang, and Kim Kashkashian. He spent four summers at the Marlboro Festival and is currently a 2024–2027 Bowers Program Artist for the Chamber Music Society of Lincoln Center.

snippet.title: Aristo Sham: 2025 Cliburn BRAHMS Piano Concerto No. 2  in B-flat Major, op. 83
snippet.description:
Seventeenth Van Cliburn International Piano Competition
Final Round Concerto 2
June 6, 2025
Bass Performance Hall

Aristo Sham, 2025 Cliburn Gold Medalist
Hong Kong, China
Age 29

Fort Worth Symphony Orchestra
Marin Alsop, conductor

BRAHMS Piano Concerto No. 2 in B-flat Major, op. 83


About Aristo
Aristo Sham’s mother taught piano in their Hong Kong home, so he says: “I was enveloped in the environment of the piano even before I was born.” His parents recall his immense curiosity towards the instrument when he was a toddler and started him in lessons (with another teacher) when he was 3. At the age of 10, he began competing and concertizing. But he also went to regular schools, never making the conscious decision of focusing solely on the piano or his other studies; this made the dual degree program at Harvard and the New England Conservatory a perfect fit when he went to college. He finished his Bachelor of Arts at Harvard in 2019 and master’s at NEC under Victor Rosenbaum in 2020. He then went to the Ingesund School of Music in Sweden to study with Julia Mustonen-Dahlkvist before returning to the States to earn an artist diploma at The Juilliard School with Robert McDonald and Orli Shaham. 

Aristo was featured in the documentary The World’s Greatest Musical Prodigies on Channel 4 (UK) and has performed for royalty, including King Charles. He’s a laureate of international competitions, with first-prize wins at Ettlingen, Gina Bachauer, and Monte Carlo Music Masters, and is on the Young Concert Artists roster. He has concertized across Asia, Europe, and the United States, with major highlights including the London Symphony Orchestra under Sir Simon Rattle, Hong Kong Philharmonic Orchestra under Edo de Waart, English Chamber Orchestra under the late Sir Raymond Leppard, Orchestre de Chambre de Lausanne, and Minnesota Orchestra. 

His interests remain varied as he pursues a career as a pianist and lists among them travel, aviation, gastronomy, oenology, and language. “I am incredibly fortunate to have enjoyed vast experiences in life and an extremely varied education, both in music and otherwise; I hope to draw from my expressive, emotional and intellectual capacity, to project an artistic voice and create unique experiences that resonate with our audiences of today.”

snippet.title: Philipp Lynov: 2025 Cliburn PROKOFIEV Piano Concerto No. 2 in G Minor, op. 16
snippet.description:
Seventeenth Van Cliburn International Piano Competition
Final Round Concerto 2
June 7, 2025
Bass Performance Hall

Philipp Lynov
Russia
Age 26

Fort Worth Symphony Orchestra
Marin Alsop, conductor

PROKOFIEV Piano Concerto No. 2 in G Minor, op. 16

About Philipp
Philipp Lynov saw a piano for the first time when he was in kindergarten. The moment left such a lasting impression on him that he credits it—the fascination of owning a piano and childhood curiosity—with his start in music. He started learning at the age of 6 as “simply a source of joy,” then earned a spot at the Central Music School at the Moscow Tchaikovsky Conservatory at the age of 14, studying with Natalia Bogdanova. He went on to complete his bachelor’s there as well, under Eliso Virsaladze. He then moved to Germany, where he's studied with Claudio Martinez Mehner and Nina Tichman at the Hochschule für Musik und Tanz Köln since 2022.  

Philipp has won first prizes at international competitions, including Xiamen (China), Takamatsu (Japan), and Paderewski (Poland), among others. Concerts have taken him around the globe—to Russia, Germany, Austria, Poland, Spain, Italy, Israel, Switzerland, Australia, and Japan—with highlights including his 2023 debut in the Main Auditorium of the Berlin Philharmonic with the Sinfonieorchester Berlin. When it comes to engaging audiences, he says: “I believe that every person possesses their own unique brilliance. To captivate audiences with music, it’s essential to communicate something meaningful—something that, while not always easy to define, resonates deeply.”

snippet.title: Vitaly Starikov: 2025 Cliburn SCHUMANN Piano Concerto in A Minor, op. 54
snippet.description:
Seventeenth Van Cliburn International Piano Competition
Final Round Concerto 2
June 7, 2025
Bass Performance Hall

Vitaly Starikov
Israel/Russia
Age 30

Fort Worth Symphony Orchestra
Marin Alsop, conductor

SCHUMANN Piano Concerto in A Minor, op. 54

About Vitaly
Born into a family of musicians, Vitaly Starikov’s journey started when his parents enrolled him to sing in a children’s music group at age 3, and he went on to Ural Musical School for Gifted Children in his native Yekaterinburg at 7. He made his concerto debut at age 10 with the Ural State Russian Folk Orchestra, and his recital debut three years later, in the small hall of the Ural Special Music School. It was at 14 that he committed his life to music. His “dream came true” when he began studying with Vera Gornostayeva, one of the world’s most venerated teachers, at the Moscow Tchaikovsky Conservatory. At that time, her student, Vadym Kholodenko, had just won the 2013 Cliburn Competition, which greatly inspired Vitaly: “and it was then that the thought was born to someday participate in this competition.” He went on to earn his bachelor’s degree at the Conservatory and then his master’s degree, under the tutelage of Eliso Virsaladze. He’s now at the Yale School of Music, pursuing an artist diploma under Boris Berman and is a laureate of the Queen Elisabeth and Sydney International Competitions.

Recital and chamber music appearances have taken him around the world, notably to Austria, Australia, Slovakia, Israel, Cyprus, Italy, France, Belgium, and Malaysia, with highlights including Sydney Opera House, Queen Elisabeth Hall, and the Great Hall of the Moscow Conservatory. He has performed with the Antwerp and Belgian National Orchestras, Sydney Symphony Orchestra, Belarusian State Symphony Orchestra, and St. Petersburg Symphony, and toured with the Orchestre national de Metz Grand Est. He holds a strong commitment to new music and has won accolades for his performances of it, including at the Queen Elisabeth (Belgium), Jaen (Spain), and Taneyev (Russia) international competitions. “I want to present works that reflect not only tradition but also contemporary life, offering new perspectives on familiar music and introducing lesser-known pieces to wider audiences.”

snippet.title: Carter Johnson: 2025 Cliburn RAVEL Piano Concerto for the Left Hand in D Major
snippet.description:
Seventeenth Van Cliburn International Piano Competition
Final Round Concerto 2
June 7, 2025
Bass Performance Hall

Carter Johnson
Canada/United States
Age 28

Fort Worth Symphony Orchestra
Marin Alsop, conductor

RAVEL Piano Concerto for the Left Hand in D Major

About Carter
Carter Johnson only ever remembers wanting to become a concert pianist since his grandmother encouraged him toward the instrument when he was 5. Growing up on Vancouver Island, he studied with Shelley Roberts for 12 years before attending the University of British Columbia, where he completed a bachelor’s under Mark Anderson. He moved to the United States in 2019 to study with Joseph Kalichstein and Matti Raekallio at The Juilliard School (master’s) and has spent the last four years in New Haven, living with his wife and two children while attending the Yale School of Music under the tutelage of Wei-Yi Yang (master’s and now doctorate studies).  

The silver medalist of the 2024 Gina Bachauer International Piano Competition, he has performed with the Montréal Symphony Orchestra, Polish National Radio Symphony Orchestra, Orchestre Métropolitain, Utah Symphony, Poznań Philharmonic Orchestra, Victoria Symphony Orchestra, and Orchestra of the Americas, and his playing has been broadcasted by CBC Radio and medici.tv. Venue highlights include the Maison Symphonique, Chan Centre for the Performing Arts, Kaufmann Concert Hall at the 92nd Street Y, Shenzhen Concert Hall, Salle Bourgie, and Warsaw National Philharmonic Hall. 

Carter has a particular interest in bringing light to lesser-explored parts of the repertory, most recently championing a collection of works by nearly forgotten Polish composers. He’s an experienced vocal coach, is enthusiastic about languages, and has also studied oboe, voice, and harpsichord. Trained in elocution as a teenager, he holds an ATCL with distinction in speech and drama from Trinity College London, which serves him well in recital: he loves speaking with audiences to bring them further into the music and its story. He also finds great inspiration outside of classical music—in his family, film, nature, food, and non-classical artists like Björk and Brian Eno, whom he says help him to think outside the box.

snippet.title: Angel Stanislav Wang: 2025 Cliburn RACHMANINOV Piano Concerto No. 3 in D Minor, op. 30
snippet.description:
Seventeenth Van Cliburn International Piano Competition
Final Round Concerto 2
June 6, 2025
Bass Performance Hall

Angel Stanislav Wang
United States
Age 22

Fort Worth Symphony Orchestra
Marin Alsop, conductor

RACHMANINOV Piano Concerto No. 3 in D Minor, op. 30


About Angel
Angel Stanislav Wang was born into a family of musicians in Los Angeles. His pianist parents are U.S. immigrants—his father originally from China, his mother from Russia—who established a music school in their longtime home in California. Angel was always extremely fond of performing on stage, whether playing the piano, dancing, or singing. As a small child, he would put on shows in their living room, paying careful attention to each detail, from lighting and special effects to costumes and sets. “Classical music was always present. When I first heard the works of Rachmaninov and Tchaikovsky, I ran to the piano, trying to repeat the beautiful harmonic shifts and endless melodies that captivated me when listening to these composers.” His mother began serious piano lessons with him when he was 5, and he immediately showed immense promise. Wanting him to be trained in the same school of music that she had, his mother moved him to her native Moscow in 2013, where he would live with his grandparents and attend the Gnessin Special School of Music (with Tatiana Zelikman). He joined Natalia Trull’s studio at Central Music School and then the Moscow Tchaikovsky Conservatory in 2020, where he continues to study today. 

A winner of more than 35 international competitions (and a silver medal at the 2023 Tchaikovsky), Angel regularly concertizes in the United States, Germany, Russia, Switzerland, Austria, Spain, Italy, Croatia; he’s performed at Carnegie Hall, Musikverein (Vienna, Austria), the Great, Small, and Rachmaninov Halls of the Moscow Conservatory, Concert Halls of the Mariinsky Theatre (St. Petersburg), and Tchaikovsky Concert Hall (Moscow). The 22-year-old loves traveling to different countries: “Whenever I have the chance, I visit different museums, theatres, and art exhibitions. It is interesting to experience the different cultures, mentalities, and ideas, as well as interests, of other people.”

A winner of more than 35 international competitions (and a silver medal at the 2023 Tchaikovsky), Angel regularly concertizes in the United States, Germany, Russia, Switzerland, Austria, Spain, Italy, Croatia; he’s performed at Carnegie Hall, Musikverein (Vienna, Austria), the Great, Small, and Rachmaninov Halls of the Moscow Conservatory, Concert Halls of the Mariinsky Theatre (St. Petersburg), and Tchaikovsky Concert Hall (Moscow). The 22-year-old loves traveling to different countries: “Whenever I have the chance, I visit different museums, theatres, and art exhibitions. It is interesting to experience the different cultures, mentalities, and ideas, as well as interests, of other people.”

About Angel
Angel Stanislav Wang was born into a family of musicians in Los Angeles. His pianist parents are U.S. immigrants—his father originally from China, his mother from Russia—who established a music school in their longtime home in California. Angel was always extremely fond of performing on stage, whether playing the piano, dancing, or singing. As a small child, he would put on shows in their living room, paying careful attention to each detail, from lighting and special effects to costumes and sets. “Classical music was always present. When I first heard the works of Rachmaninov and Tchaikovsky, I ran to the piano, trying to repeat the beautiful harmonic shifts and endless melodies that captivated me when listening to these composers.” His mother began serious piano lessons with him when he was 5, and he immediately showed immense promise. Wanting him to be trained in the same school of music that she had, his mother moved him to her native Moscow in 2013, where he would live with his grandparents and attend the Gnessin Special School of Music (with Tatiana Zelikman). He joined Natalia Trull’s studio at Central Music School and then the Moscow Tchaikovsky Conservatory in 2020, where he continues to study today. 

A winner of more than 35 international competitions (and a silver medal at the 2023 Tchaikovsky), Angel regularly concertizes in the United States, Germany, Russia, Switzerland, Austria, Spain, Italy, Croatia; he’s performed at Carnegie Hall, Musikverein (Vienna, Austria), the Great, Small, and Rachmaninov Halls of the Moscow Conservatory, Concert Halls of the Mariinsky Theatre (St. Petersburg), and Tchaikovsky Concert Hall (Moscow). The 22-year-old loves traveling to different countries: “Whenever I have the chance, I visit different museums, theatres, and art exhibitions. It is interesting to experience the different cultures, mentalities, and ideas, as well as interests, of other people.”

ta.title: கிளிபர்ன் போட்டியின் இறுதிப் போட்டியாளர்கள் தங்கள் அம்மாக்களுடன் நேர்காணல்களுக்கு எதிர்வினையாற்று...
ta.description: கிளிபர்ன் போட்டியின் இறுதிப் போட்டியாளர்கள் அறிவிக்கப்பட்ட 12 மணி நேரத்திற்குப் பிறகு, மூன்று பியானோ கலைஞர்களின் (எவ்ரென் ஓசெல், விட்டலி ஸ்டாரிகோவ் மற்றும் ஏஞ்சல் ஸ்டானிஸ்லாவ் வாங்) பெற்றோரை நாங்கள் நேர்காணல் செய்து, அவர்களின் பதில்களுக்கு எதிர்வினையாற்றச் செய்தோம்.

nl-NL.title: Finalisten van de Cliburn-competitie reageren op interviews met hun moeders
nl-NL.description: Slechts 12 uur nadat de finalisten van de Cliburn-competitie bekend waren gemaakt, interviewden we de ouders van drie pianisten (Evren Ozel, Vitaly Starikov en Angel Stanislav Wang) en vroegen we hen om te reageren op hun antwoorden.

pl.title: Finaliści konkursu Cliburn reagują na wywiady ze swoimi mamami
pl.description: Zaledwie 12 godzin po ogłoszeniu finalistów Konkursu Cliburna przeprowadziliśmy wywiady z rodzicami trójki pianistów (Evrena Ozela, Vitaly’ego Starikov i Angela Stanislava Wanga) i poprosiliśmy ich o ustosunkowanie się do ich odpowiedzi.

ja.title: クライバーン・コンクールのファイナリストが母親へのインタビューに答える
ja.description: クライバーン・コンクールのファイナリストが発表されてからわずか12時間後、私たちは3人のピアニスト（エヴレン・オゼル、ヴィタリー・スタリコフ、アンヘル・スタニスラフ・ワン）の両親にインタビューし、彼らの回答に対する反応を聞きました。

iw.title: פיינליסטים בתחרות קליבורן מגיבים לראיונות עם אמהותיהם
iw.description: 12 שעות בלבד לאחר שהוכרזו פיינליסטים של תחרות קליבורן, ראיינו את הוריהם של שלושה פסנתרנים (אוורן אוזל, ויטלי סטאריקוב ואנג'ל סטניסלב וואנג) וביקשנו מהם להגיב לתשובותיהם.

ko.title: 클라이번 경연대회 결선 진출자들이 엄마와의 인터뷰에 반응하다
ko.description: 클라이번 콩쿠르 결선 진출자가 발표된 지 불과 12시간 만에, 우리는 세 명의 피아니스트(에브렌 오젤, 비탈리 스타리코프, 앤젤 스타니슬라브 왕)의 부모에게 인터뷰를 진행하여 그들의 답변에 대한 반응을 들었습니다.

bn.title: ক্লাইবার্ন প্রতিযোগিতার ফাইনালিস্টরা তাদের মায়ের সাক্ষাৎকারে প্রতিক্রিয়া জানাচ্ছেন
bn.description: ক্লিবার্ন প্রতিযোগিতার ফাইনালিস্টদের ঘোষণার মাত্র ১২ ঘন্টা পরে, আমরা তিনজন পিয়ানোবাদকের (এভরেন ওজেল, ভিটালি স্টারিকভ এবং অ্যাঞ্জেল স্ট্যানিস্লাভ ওয়াং) বাবা-মায়ের সাক্ষাৎকার নিয়েছিলাম এবং তাদের উত্তরের প্রতি প্রতিক্রিয়া জানাতে বাধ্য করেছিলাম।

uk.title: Фіналісти конкурсу Кліберна реагують на інтерв'ю зі своїми мамами

ml.title: ക്ലിബേൺ മത്സര ഫൈനലിസ്റ്റുകൾ അവരുടെ അമ്മമാരുമായുള്ള അഭിമുഖങ്ങളോട് പ്രതികരിക്കുന്നു
ml.description: ക്ലിബേൺ മത്സര ഫൈനലിസ്റ്റുകളെ പ്രഖ്യാപിച്ച് വെറും 12 മണിക്കൂറിനുശേഷം, മൂന്ന് പിയാനിസ്റ്റുകളുടെ (എവ്രെൻ ഓസൽ, വിറ്റാലി സ്റ്റാരിക്കോവ്, ഏഞ്ചൽ സ്റ്റാനിസ്ലാവ് വാങ്) മാതാപിതാക്കളുമായി ഞങ്ങൾ അഭിമുഖം നടത്തി, അവരുടെ ഉത്തരങ്ങളോട് പ്രതികരിക്കാൻ അവരെ പ്രേരിപ്പിച്ചു.

snippet.title: 2025 Cliburn Backstage: Jonathan Mamora, Preliminary Round
snippet.description:
Cliburn Backstage with Greg Anderson (‪  ‪  @gregandersonpiano   )
Interviews, curation, and editing by Greg Anderson

Seventeenth Van Cliburn International Piano Competition
May 21–June 7, 2025

Jonathan Mamora, United States, 30
https://cliburn.org/competitions/2025-cliburn-competition/2025-competitors/jonathan-mamora

About Jonathan
Jonathan Mamora remembers being a 4-year-old who was very jealous of his brother’s piano lessons. His father wanted them both to learn so that they could play in church, but the older sibling was enrolled first. Jonathan would listen, remember the notes his brother practiced, and then try to replicate them—eventually discovering on his own how the dots on the pages corresponded to the notes the instrument played. He says he was immediately hooked and has been ever since. 

The Indonesian-American, Southern California native earned a bachelor’s in music from La Sierra University with Elvin Rodriguez and a master’s at The Juilliard School with Hung-Kuan Chen. This year, he completed a doctorate from the Eastman School of Music under Douglas Humpherys. 
Jonathan is the first-prize winner of a number of international piano competitions, most recently the 2025 Hilton Head, 2023 Scottish, 2023 Maria Canals Barcelona, and 2022 Olga Kern. He has performed throughout North and South America, Europe, and Asia, with highlights including a 2023 debut at Carnegie Hall and engagements with the Royal Scottish National Orchestra, New Amsterdam Symphony Orchestra, and New Mexico Philharmonic. His career to date has been truly multifaceted: he’s been a church musician much of his life; enjoys collaborating with vocalists, instrumentalists, ensembles, and choirs; and has also performed as a percussionist, vocalist, historical keyboardist (harpsichord, fortepiano), and conductor. 

Jonathan values education as an important tool in music making. He has previously taught at the Eastman School of Music and The Juilliard School and has conducted master classes and lessons in the United States, the Caribbean, South America, and Europe.

snippet.description:
Cliburn Backstage with Greg Anderson (‪     @gregandersonpiano       )
Interviews, curation, and editing by Greg Anderson

Seventeenth Van Cliburn International Piano Competition
May 21–June 7, 2025

Kotaro Shigemori, Japan, 25
https://cliburn.org/competitions/2025-cliburn-competition/2025-competitors/kotaro-shigemori

About Kotaro
Kotaro Shigemori began piano lessons with his mother when he was 6, and his passion and talent for the instrument grew quickly. He earned a bachelor’s and artist diploma from Toho Gakuen College in Tokyo under Michiko Okamoto and Katsurako Mikami, and won many national competition prizes in Japan. He says that placing at the Long-Thibaud International Competition in 2022 gave him great motivation and strength; it was at that moment that he could see himself as “a pianist who could be active in the world.” 

Kotaro then moved to France in 2023 to study with Rena Shereshevskaya at the École normale de musique de Paris, Alfred Cortot. Over the last two years, he’s published six columns in Piano Magazine (Japan) about his experiences studying abroad. In addition to appearances at the La Folle Journée, Miyazaki International Music Festival, Ishikawa, and Wind and Green Music Festival, he’s performed at Suntory Hall with the Tokyo Philharmonic Orchestra, Ishikawa Prefectural Concert Hall with the Orchestra Ensemble Kanazawa, Fukui Concert Hall with Aichi Central Symphony Orchestra, and Paris’ Théâtre du Châtelet with Orchestre de la Garde républicaine. Through performance, he believes musicians “should cherish the feeling of healing the hearts of the listeners.” He was awarded the Ezaki Scholarship in 2023, and the Rohm Music Foundation and Ezoe Memorial Recruit Scholarships in 2024 and 2025.

snippet.title: 2025 Cliburn Backstage: Carter Johnson, Prokofiev Piano Concerto No. 2
snippet.description:
Cliburn Backstage with Greg Anderson (‪    @gregandersonpiano     )
Interviews, curation, and editing by Greg Anderson

Seventeenth Van Cliburn International Piano Competition
May 21–June 7, 2025

Watch Carter's Prokofiev Piano Concerto No. 2: https://youtu.be/ylFy1UpKP5w

Carter Johnson, Canada/United States, 28
https://cliburn.org/competitions/2025-cliburn-competition/2025-competitors/carter-johnson

About Carter
Carter Johnson only ever remembers wanting to become a concert pianist since his grandmother encouraged him toward the instrument when he was 5. Growing up on Vancouver Island, he studied with Shelley Roberts for 12 years before attending the University of British Columbia, where he completed a bachelor’s under Mark Anderson. He moved to the United States in 2019 to study with Joseph Kalichstein and Matti Raekallio at The Juilliard School (master’s) and has spent the last four years in New Haven, living with his wife and two children while attending the Yale School of Music under the tutelage of Wei-Yi Yang (master’s and now doctorate studies).  

The silver medalist of the 2024 Gina Bachauer International Piano Competition, he has performed with the Montréal Symphony Orchestra, Polish National Radio Symphony Orchestra, Orchestre Métropolitain, Utah Symphony, Poznań Philharmonic Orchestra, Victoria Symphony Orchestra, and Orchestra of the Americas, and his playing has been broadcasted by CBC Radio and medici.tv. Venue highlights include the Maison Symphonique, Chan Centre for the Performing Arts, Kaufmann Concert Hall at the 92nd Street Y, Shenzhen Concert Hall, Salle Bourgie, and Warsaw National Philharmonic Hall. 

Carter has a particular interest in bringing light to lesser-explored parts of the repertory, most recently championing a collection of works by nearly forgotten Polish composers. He’s an experienced vocal coach, is enthusiastic about languages, and has also studied oboe, voice, and harpsichord. Trained in elocution as a teenager, he holds an ATCL with distinction in speech and drama from Trinity College London, which serves him well in recital: he loves speaking with audiences to bring them further into the music and its story. He also finds great inspiration outside of classical music—in his family, film, nature, food, and non-classical artists like Björk and Brian Eno, whom he says help him to think outside the box.
